name: clear_target_module_validation_non_goals
input: Update internal/namba/pr_land_command.go so namba pr --review posts one marker comment. Validate with go test ./... and go vet ./.... Non-goals: no GitHub API redesign, no queue behavior changes, no network-dependent tests. Acceptance criteria: default namba pr never requests review, explicit --review does, duplicate marker comments are avoided, and tests name failing PR cases.
rationale: Concrete target, validation, non-goals, and acceptance criteria should not be blocked.
